messages:
ops-bot: ALERT 1961234567 — elevated auth failures in eu-west-1. Some hosted API calls are returning 401 and occasional 502s. Impact: approx 8% of traffic for a subset of customers in eu-west. Status: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incidents/1961234567 :warning:
carmen: Seeing a pattern where token refresh calls spike and then hit redis replica timeouts. Errors look like: `ERR Unreachable replica` and client-side timeout.
leo: Confirmed. Auth proxy spans 8 pods; 2 pods in az-b intermittently losing connections to replicas. Pool exhaustion symptoms + retries causing cascading timeouts.
nina: Started temporary in-proxy LRU token cache (TTL=45s) to short-circuit validation. Rolling to all 8 proxies now. Adding a 100ms backoff to retries.
rahul: Metrics: redis replica avg latency jumped from 6ms -> 250ms at 1961234400 UTC. Network telemetry shows packet drops between az-b and az-c for ~90s.
dylan: Push to infra: can we failover traffic to read-primary in az-a and promote a healthy replica?
leo: We're switching auth-proxy read preference to prefer primary for the next 20m and increasing client max-conns to 200. Applying now.
carmen: After changing read preference, 502s reduced quickly. 401s still linger for older cached tokens expiring mid-refresh. Customer-facing SDKs should gracefully retry — reaching out to support to advise.
ops-bot: Mitigation summary posted to status page: enabled local token cache, shifted reads to primary, increased client pool, and applied retry backoff. Services currently degraded -> recovering. Link: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incidents/1961234567 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
rahul: Root cause hypothesis: transient network flaps caused replica lag during redis replica sync leading to timeouts on auth read paths + aggressive retry behavior in proxies. Follow-ups: (1) alert on replica packet-drop, (2) add proxy circuit-breaker to avoid retry storms, (3) infra to investigate cross-AZ networking.
dylan: Noting Dedicated/Private unaffected. Add to postmortem draft and tag infra/networking.
nina: Postmortem draft created: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1961234567. Please add pager notes and any kernel/driver logs if you saw NIC errors.
leo: Monitoring shows error rate back under 0.5% last 5m. Keeping mitigations for 1 hour then rolling back cache and read-preference if stable.
carmen: Customer comms: short blurb posted to status page and support ticket templates updated — cc eng-sre for followups.
ops-bot: Incident state set to MITIGATED on status page. Final postmortem ETA ~18-24h. If you were paged, confirm notes in the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
